workflow: A concurrency test submits a mix of immediately completable and deliberately delayed work, then waits for early results under a fixed short deadline.
Heavy system load or execution instrumentation delays worker startup and scheduling beyond that deadline.
The wait expires before the immediately completable work has run, leaving no or only partial results.
The test assumes the early results must always be present and reports a failure even though the timeout behavior is otherwise valid.
decision_reason: This is distinct from the existing clusters: the failure is caused by a timing-sensitive test assumption under delayed worker startup, not by memory corruption, synchronization-state misuse, or an incorrect runtime result.
